failure_reason: Akamai Bot Manager locked this session out mid-extraction: after roughly 20 successful category-page reads it returned HTTP 403 to every same-origin fetch of a /pl/ or /c/ URL and served a full 'Access Denied' page to real tab navigations of the same paths. It did not clear across ~25 minutes of backoff (repeated waits plus a fresh tab), so 51 leaf nodes could not have their exact itemCount read and are emitted with qty:null rather than a guessed or derived number. The category tree itself is complete and was captured before the block.
notes: ACCESS: everything was read through the Claude-in-Chrome connector in my own tab -- no curl/requests/WebFetch/proxy of any kind. robots.txt was opened in the tab first: it names no Claude/anthropic/ClaudeBot agent, and the User-agent:* block disallows only /search?*, /*_/N-*, order and account servlets and similar; the /c/ and /pl/ category paths are allowed. TREE: Lowe's has a real Furniture department at /c/Furniture-Home-decor with six sub-departments (Living Room, Dining & Kitchen, Bedroom, Office, Entryway, Kids) plus Folding Tables & Chairs, and a separate outdoor department at /c/Patio-furniture-Outdoors. Department child lists came from the rendered /c/ landing pages' own alphabetical sub-category lists; deeper levels came from the 'subCategories' array embedded in each /pl/ listing page's server-rendered JSON (name, url and a leaf flag per child). Lowe's also emits many SEO refinement links whose nav id is a compound 'a-b' pair (e.g. .../couches-sofas-loveseats/sectional/1650307256-3370428401, .../chairs/accent/4294770537-4294965394); those are facet/filter pages rather than catalogue nodes and were excluded per the filter-page rule. COUNTS: source of truth is the listing page's own rendered header ('N results'). I verified that the server-rendered field "pageName":"ProductList","itemCount":N is exactly that header's number on two pages loaded and read in the browser (Waterbeds: header '64 results', itemCount 64; Couches, Sofas & Loveseats: header '51330 results', itemCount 51330), then harvested itemCount for further nodes by same-origin fetch() from the loaded lowes.com page context. SANITY CHECKS: (a) the number changes per category (64 Waterbeds vs 51330 sofas vs 7614 Kids Furniture), so it is not a site-wide constant; (b) the <title>/h1 of every page was checked against the category requested, so no silently-served parent listing; (c) the 'productCount' figure carried inside a parent's subCategories array is STALE/INFLATED and was deliberately NOT used -- it claimed 15418 for Coffee Tables while that page's own itemCount/header was 14856, so subCategories was used for structure only; (d) no parent total was summed from children and no child was given a parent's number (Patio Conversation Sets 30044 + Patio Dining Sets 12417 exceed their parent Patio Furniture Sets 32967 because Lowe's nodes overlap -- only leaves are recorded). The large absolute numbers are consistent with Lowe's third-party marketplace assortment. EXCLUDED (and why): Mattresses, Air Mattresses, Box Springs, Futon Mattresses (bedding, not furniture); Slipcovers, Patio Furniture Covers, Furniture Parts (furniture covers/care/parts); Indoor Chair Cushions and Patio Cushions & Pillows (textiles); Blanket Ladders & Storage and Deck Boxes (standalone storage goods, reserved for the Storage task); Office Accessories, Dry Erase & Bulletin Boards, Library Ladders & Hardware, Umbrella Stands (office supplies / boards / hardware / accessories); Outdoor Privacy Screens, Gazebos, Pergolas & Canopies, Patio Umbrellas (outdoor structures and shade, not furniture); Fire Pits, Patio Heaters, Grills (appliances); and the whole non-furniture side of this home-improvement catalogue -- bathroom fixtures (sinks, toilets, tubs, faucets), fitted kitchen cabinetry sold as a building product, building materials, flooring, lighting, mirrors, rugs, wall art, home accents -- per the primary-product-type rule. Bathroom vanities were considered and left out: Lowe's sells them as fitted bathroom building product inside the Bathroom department, not under Furniture. DUPLICATE NODES: Lowe's exposes the same nav id under two parents in two places (4294772294 as both 'Accent Cabinets' in Living Room and 'Chests' in Bedroom; 4294770534 as both 'Benches' in Living Room and 'Entryway Benches' in Entryway). Each is recorded once and flagged.
